description:
Blue Sky Innovators (BSI) is seeking a Software Developer to support ground software development for a satellite program. This role will work alongside engineers, program managers, and government stakeholders to design, develop, test, and maintain mission-critical ground software supporting space systems.

 Responsibilities

 
 Develop, test, and maintain ground software components in Python supporting satellite mission operations

 Collaborate with systems engineers, program managers, and government customers to translate mission requirements into software solutions

 Support the full software development lifecycle, including design, implementation, integration, test, and deployment

 Participate in code reviews, unit testing, and verification/validation activities to ensure flight software reliability and mission assurance

 Troubleshoot and resolve software defects and anomalies identified during development, integration, and on-orbit operations

 Support technical documentation, including design documents, test plans, and software interface specifications

 Coordinate with cross-functional teams to support satellite program milestones, reviews, and delivery schedules

 Adhere to applicable software development standards and mission assurance practices for space systems

 
 Required Qualifications

 
 Active TS/SCI clearance with Counterintelligence (CI) Polygraph

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field

 Minimum 5 years of experience supporting flight software development

 Proficiency in Python and related systems

 Ability to work on-site full-time in Alexandria, VA

 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering and program teams

 
 Preferred Qualifications

 
 Experience with satellite ground systems, spacecraft bus software, or mission operations software

 Familiarity with software development in a classified/SCIF environment

 Experience with version control, CI/CD pipelines, or Agile development practices

 Prior DoD or IC space program experience

 
 Salary range for the position is $150,000 - $200,000 per year. Specific compensation will be determined by several factors including experience, education, skills, and knowledge. We also offer medical/dental/vision benefits and 401k contribution.

 Blue Sky Innovators provides professional services to operational, intelligence, and technology development programs within the Department of Defense (DoD) and Intelligence Community (IC).

  
 Blue Sky Innovators, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you are a qualified job seeker with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request an accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access http://www.blueskyinnovators.com as a result of your disability. To request an accommodation, please email us at careers@blueskyinnovators.com and provide your name and contact information. Please note: this is only for job seekers with disabilities requesting an accommodation.
